items.title: Complete magicescorts.com preview-readiness artifact before implementation
items.summary: Magicescorts.com is queue-ready, but analytics, affiliate, social, content-rights, compliance, security, and launch evidence are not established. Capacity records also conflict, so production implementation cannot be admitted this cycle.
items.requested_action: Create a dated, read-only readiness artifact in the magicescorts.com repository, preserving the site as unpublished or otherwise unchanged. Record the approved concept scope, content and image provenance, disclosure and consent requirements, security and release boundaries, affiliate readiness, measurement availability, rollback point, and exactly one next implementation step. Do not infer adult status, publish, monetize, add tracking, spend, contact external parties, or change production.
